text.brief: In the spring of 2029 a new government in Taipei receives a draft text from the Taiwan Affairs Office. The government could come from any party. The draft offers tariff-free trade, tourism and a "framework for peace across the Strait" in return for a pause in arms purchases and talks on "reunification arrangements."
text.record: Taiwan elects a president in January 2028. Xi Jinping hosted the chair of the Kuomintang in Beijing on April 10, 2026, and both sides endorsed the 1992 Consensus ([gov.cn](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202604/10/content_WS69d87623c6d00ca5f9a0a527.html)). The Party's Anti-Secession Law of 2005 authorizes "non-peaceful means" if peaceful unification becomes impossible.
text.reading: The Party offers prosperity with a clock attached. Each benefit arrives now, and each obligation arrives later in language the Party will interpret. A pause in arms purchases hollows the deterrent while the talks run. This is Stratagem 10, hide a knife behind a smile.
text.coreEvent: Taipei and Beijing open formal political talks before 2032.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. Outside powers either pressure Taipei toward talks or away from them, and both choices override the voters who must live with the result.
text.fix: Hold one principle. Taiwan's people decide, and American commitments stay on schedule while they do.
